submission: Final state: xarray/core/computation.py only file modified. `xr.where(cond, x, y, keep_attrs=None)` now threads keep_attrs into apply_ufunc; when attributes are kept it uses a `_first_non_empty_attrs` combiner so attrs come from the first of (cond, x, y) that actually carries them (cond from a comparison is usually empty), preserving attrs for DataArray, Variable and Dataset variables, while keep_attrs=False and the default/global option still drop attrs.
